L4·N10906unmasked layer
This neuron is essentially a novelty/repetition detector: it fires on tokens that are unpredictable first-time continuations (a name, a list-item verb, a dash or comma opening a new clause) and is strongly negative on tokens that copy a phrase already stated earlier in the passage (e.g. the second "Food" in "Shame Food", the repeated "SPAB", "Shadow", "Termite").
